ownership.quote: In October 2021, OVHcloud filed its IPO and is listed on the Euronext Paris, the Paris Stock Exchange as OVH. In December 2021, OVHcloud became part of the Paris SBF120 index.

stage.quote: In October 2021, OVHcloud filed its IPO and is listed on the Euronext Paris, the Paris Stock Exchange as OVH.
stage.note: Founded 1999 by Octave Klaba (bootstrapped for most of its history); took private-equity investment from KKR and TowerBrook in 2016, then IPO'd on Euronext Paris in October 2021. Klaba family retains a majority/controlling stake post-IPO. Last priced private round before IPO was the 2016 KKR/TowerBrook round.

total_funding_usd.basis: Only disclosed pre-IPO external funding round found (Wikipedia, citing the 2016 KKR/TowerBrook deal); does not include IPO proceeds. OVH was self-funded/bootstrapped by the Klaba family for its first ~17 years.
total_funding_usd.quote: In October 2016, OVH raised $250 million in order to raise further international expansion. This funding round valued OVH at over US$1 billion.

last_round.quote: "OVH Partners with KKR and TowerBrook for Further Global Expansion" ... In October 2016, OVH raised $250 million in order to raise further international expansion. This funding round valued OVH at over US$1 billion.

revenue.basis: Wikipedia infobox figure (≈897M EUR converted at ≈1.077 USD/EUR); OVHcloud is a public company reporting audited annual revenue on Euronext Paris.

note: OVHcloud is a publicly traded French cloud/hosting company (Euronext Paris: OVH), founded 1999 in Roubaix by Octave Klaba, bootstrapped for most of its life, took a $250M KKR/TowerBrook investment in 2016 (>$1B valuation), then IPO'd in October 2021. Net income was negative (−€10.3M, 2024 per Wikipedia infobox), so it is not yet consistently profitable despite public-company status and ~3,074 employees (2025).
